# Andy Jehan

Andy Jehan is the current Connétable of [St John](https://flow.je/elections/st-john) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2021.

Andy Jehan has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2021 St John Connétable By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/andy-jehan#e46)

  Elected as Connétable of St John unopposed.
- [**2022 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/andy-jehan#e49)

  Elected as Connétable of St John.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/andy-jehan/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lH9rGgmGDfk)
  - [2022 Jersey Evangelical Alliance Survey](https://www.jerseyevangelicalalliance.org.je/s/Andy-Jehan-Connetable-St-John-JEA-Questionnaire.pdf)

Andy Jehan has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St John](https://flow.je/elections/st-john). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/16/parish-is-the-priority-constable-set-to-give-up-ministerial-role-in-seeking-re-election/)\]

## Election History

### 2021 St John Connétable By-Election

By-Election following the removal of Chris Taylor by the Royal Court (1 seat), 31st March 2021.

**Andy Jehan was elected as Connétable of St John in 2021 unopposed**.
